name: nisio-note
description: A tiny, fast notepad with markdown preview built with Bun and the system webview.

scripts.build: bun run ui && bun run icon && bun build --compile --minify --bytecode --format=esm --windows-hide-console --windows-icon=assets/icon.ico --windows-title=NISIO-Note --windows-description="A tiny notepad built with Bun" --windows-publisher=NISIO --windows-version=0.1.0 --outfile "dist/NISIO Note.exe" src/main.ts && bun scripts/windows-icons.ts
